name: atan2_lut
describe: LUT-based atan2(y,x): fastInvSqrt-normalize, asin/cos tables (257 entries) indexed via FRAC_BIAS bit trick, cubic correction, quadrant reflect. NOT bitwise: the asin/cos LUT seed differs <=1 ULP between Java StrictMath and platform libm, so output is decimal + tight tol (measured max abs dev 4.4e-16, rel 3.2e-16).
